s: Issur shena bitpillin ubo b' seipim: kol zeman shettepillin berosho o bizroo — asur lishon bahen apillu shenat aray, mippene sheggenay hu lattepillin sheyyashen bahem vehen megullin. Veim paras sudar alehen veen immo ishsha — yashen bahem shenat aray, abal lo shenat qeba, shemma yapiach bahen. Ketzad hu oseh shello yeradem bashshena veyishan shenat qeba? Yanniach rosho ben birkayv vehu yosheb veyashen. Veen bashshena mishshum hessach haddaat, lepi shehessach haddaat hu kesheomed bischoq o qallut rosh (o shemmatrid dato betzorke haggup harbeh) kemo shennitbaer besiman kach, ukesheyyashen hu shokeach kol hable olam. Abal im yesh ishsha immo bammitta — lo yishan bahem kelal, shemma yishkach vishammesh mittato. Abal im enan berosho uzeroo ella kerukin beyado — muttar lishon bahem apillu shenat qeba. Veyesh oserin lishon shenat qeba etzel hattepillin apillu keshehen munnachim al hashshulchan ad sheyyipros sudar alehen, gezera shemma yapiach. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona, shello chasheshu lahapacha ella keshehen alayv shehen tzerikin gup naqi. Veim ochazan beyado veenan kerukin beyado — asur lishon bahem apillu shenat aray shemma yippelu miyyado. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheochazan belo nartiqan, abal keshehen benartiqan — muttar apillu shenat qeba ledibre hakkol, sheen lachosh kol-kak im yippelu, vegam en lachosh kelal lahapacha ap lassebara haacharona:
Nahagu haolam lehitannot keshennopel tepillin miyyado al haaretz belo nartiqan. Vehu haddin im napal seper tora apillu benartiqo:
